title: プリティー・ガンマンズ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's our day off, and Matikanefukukitaru and I have plans to go buy new training clothes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sorry for springing this on you at the last minute, but I brought a friend along. Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I just love me a bit of shoppin'! ♪
choice_data_list: Fine by me. Why the sudden change of plans?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well, you see… The great Shiraoki revealed a prophecy to me. "On this day, you shall deepen your connections with the ones close to you."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Holy moly… Is this "Shiraoki" some kinda prophet or somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I say we ought to trust the prophet's judgment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not quite up to speed, but the three of us end up going together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this is some pretty cool gear. It has fifty lucky stars on it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ayy, nice one! Put that on and you'll look just like an American racer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Looks like we've got a little extra time on our hands…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Look over there! See that movie poster?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: There's a western playing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaw, a spaghetti western! Makes me wanna see a good ol' fashioned Mexican standoff. Bang bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's all go see it! From the looks of it, I reckon it's sure to be exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd say that! Thanks a million!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It looks like they're playing the same movie on two different screens.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: There's a normal one and an "audience participation version." …Whatever that means.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, audience participation! That's pretty popular lately. You get to cheer while you're watching the movie.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now then, time to decide our fate!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Should we sit back and relax, or really immerse ourselves in the Wild West?
choice_data_list: Let's go to the normal screening.
The audience participation screening sounds interesting.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I guess it's better to get into a no-nonsense mood and contemplate the story. I get you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's get movin', Fukukitaru! I reckon we should get ourselves a supersize servin' of popcorn for two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The movie is a classic tale of a band of heroes coming together to bring peace to a lawless town.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That was super intense, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It shot a hole in my heart, and the winds of the West are whistling right on through!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Same here! I wanna have a duel! And soak in a bubble bath while shaving my five o'clock shadow!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Maybe we should start slingin' pistols too…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, that store over there sells gun holsters!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's snap up a matching pair! We can hang them from our belts and strut around like real cowboys!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Starting today, we're the quick-draw sisters of Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Two holsters, please! Also…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Give me one of those auspicious-looking shrine ropes, please. Wait, it's a lasso?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They both seem to be really happy with their matching merchandise!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: All right, let's have a look. Though I am kind of worried the audience is gonna get real rowdy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It'll be fine, Fukukitaru! I'm sure we'll have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inside the theater…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Over there, get 'em! Pew pew!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey! I'm talkin' to you, beardy! Once I count to three, it's night night!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The audience participation screening turns out to be a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Phew, I really got into it! I feel like I've become a real rootin'-tootin' gunslinger now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Fukukitaru. Who are the gunners running this outpost here?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Why, you and me, of course! When we team up, the bad guys down in the stronghold know that they're all outta luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're really getting into their roles. It seems like the movie has got them feeling as tough as the heroes of the Wild West.
